title: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Peach & Apple 10ml E-Liquid
description: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Peach & Apple is a wonderfully smooth and layered fruit combination with a satisfyingly sweet finish. The profile brings together the juicy, authentic taste of ripe Peach and the crisp notes of sweet Red Apple to form a robust orchard base. This is seamlessly intertwined with the distinct, sugary taste of a confectionery-inspired Cherry, rounding off the mix with a deeply satisfying sweetness on the exhale. This e-liquid features Riot's Hybrid Nicotine formula, which blends Nic Salt and freebase for quick satisfaction, a smooth throat feel, and modest vapour production. With its 50VG/50PG profile, this vape juice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs well with pod kits, refillable starter kits, and compact vape pens. Made in the UK, the Riot X Nic Salts range focuses on full-impact fruit blends designed for everyday use in low-powered refillable devices.
